subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should OpenClaw change unconfigured memorySearch.sync.intervalMinutes from disabled to a default periodic fallback for existing users?
rationale: The remaining fix is narrow in code but changes default background filesystem/indexing behavior, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive fallback behavior requiring maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept default periodic fallback
options.body: Land the linked PR after fixing its scoped code blocker and proving existing-user upgrade behavior for the 30-minute default.

options.title: Keep fallback opt-in
options.body: Keep intervalMinutes at 0 by default and close or narrow the linked PR to docs/doctor guidance for users who need the workaround.

options.title: Use a different recovery surface
options.body: Prefer an explicit doctor/setup recommendation or watcher-health warning instead of changing default periodic sync behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept default periodic fallback
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after fixing its scoped code blocker and proving existing-user upgrade behavior for the 30-minute default.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to current-main memory manager/config history in the affected path.
